prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
completion:
Distinguish between:
- Data only records the numeric emissions of each factory.
- Coordinates only the geographic location of each factory.
- Timestamps only specify the measurement time to the nearest second.
- Observation logs only relate to manual readings of visible pollution.
- Legal standards only define the permissible pollution levels allowed by the law.
